tagline: A global integrated energy company producing and marketing oil, natural gas, renewables and electricity
hero_kpi_rationale: TotalEnergies is making significant investments in the energy transition, particularly in renewable energy and electricity, which is a key driver of its future strategy.

kpis.name: Investments (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Expenditures dedicated to the acquisition or improvement of long-term physical assets.
kpis.description: TotalEnergies' capital expenditures (CAPEX) focus on developing energy projects, including renewables and electricity.
kpis.signal: Stable investments in the energy transition.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects profitability of operations before accounting for operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in gross margin, impacted by energy prices.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by revenue, indicating profitability of core business activities.
kpis.description: Operating margin measures the performance of the company's ongoing operations.
kpis.signal: Declining operating margin, reflecting market conditions.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenditures expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D investments support innovation in new energy technologies and the transition to sustainable energy.
kpis.signal: Stable R&D investment, focused on energy innovation and transition.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company at the end of the period.
kpis.description: The number of employees represents the company's workforce, essential to its operations in the global energy sector.
kpis.signal: Stable workforce with approximately 102,579 employees across 120 countries.

kpis.name: Digital Acceleration
kpis.explanation: Adoption of digital technologies and artificial intelligence to optimize operations and performance.
kpis.description: TotalEnergies is integrating AI and digital acceleration into its operations to optimize exploration, production, and energy management.
kpis.signal: Ongoing strategic initiative mentioned in section 1.6.3 of the integrated report.

kpis.name: OneTech R&D Strategy
kpis.explanation: Consolidated research and development strategy supporting the energy transition and technological innovation.
kpis.description: OneTech represents TotalEnergies' unified approach to R&D for developing sustainable energy solutions.
kpis.signal: Key lever of the transition strategy mentioned in section 1.6 of the integrated report.

ai_positioning.summary: TotalEnergies is integrating artificial intelligence and digital acceleration into its operations to optimize exploration, production, and energy management, while developing innovative solutions for its customers and supporting its energy transition.
evidence: Innovation for the transition strategy of TotalEnergies (Section 1.6)
Digital acceleration as a performance lever (Section 1.6.3)
R&D, lever of the transition strategy (Section 1.6.2)
Use of AI for operational optimization and development of new sustainable energy offerings
